name: Series 65E Optical Smoke Detector With Flashing Led
legacyName: Series 65E Optical Smoke Detector With Flashing Led
family: Context Plus UL EU Approved Series 65E Detectors
summary: The Context Plus Conventional Series 65E Optical Smoke Detector incorporates an optical chamber that houses an infrared light emitting diode (LED) and a photo-diode which has an integral visible-light filter as extra protection against ambient light. Wide-operating voltage of 9–33VDC. Wide-operating and storage temperature of -20°C to +60°C. Can be used on security systems. Proven detection performance. It has an indicator LED which is clear in quiescent state but produces a red light in alarm. Responds well to slow-burning, smouldering fires. Well-suited to bedrooms and escape routes. Unaffected by wind or atmospheric pressure. Flashing LED.
